title: Acquirer: Ancient Order of Foresters in Victoria Freindly Society Limited; Target: Ausdef Ltd
acquirers: Ancient Order of Foresters in Victoria Freindly Society Limited

body_sections.Summary: On 31 May 2004, APRA informed the ACCC of the proposed transfer of Annuity Benefit Fund Number 1 from Ausdef Ltd to Ancient Order of Foresters in Victoria Friendly Society.
body_sections.Market definition: For competition assessment purposes the relevant product market in this instance was treated as a broadly defined market for insurance services.  Even on a narrower definition it appears that a substantial lessening of competition is unlikely.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The acquisition does not cross the ACCC's threshold for either the exercise of unilateral market power or combined market power.
